SELECT c.campaign_id,c.business_id,c.sender_id,c.campaign_name,c.state,c.total,c.create_date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.state='SUBMITTING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) submitting, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.submitted_date IS NOT NULL OR m.state IN ('ACCEPTED','SENT','DELIVERED','READ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) accepted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.sent_date IS NOT NULL OR m.delivered_date IS NOT NULL OR m.read_date IS NOT NULL OR m.state IN ('SENT','DELIVERED','READ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) sent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.delivered_date IS NOT NULL OR m.read_date IS NOT NULL OR m.state IN ('DELIVERED','READ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) delivered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.read_date IS NOT NULL OR m.state='READ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) read_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.failed_date IS NOT NULL OR m.state='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.state='UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) unknown_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.state='CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) cancelled FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN outbound_messages m ON m.campaign_id=c.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND c.business_id=#{businessId} GROUP BY c.campaign_id,c.business_id,c.sender_id,c.campaign_name,c.state,c.total,c.create_date
